title: Procedural picket-fence section (Python (trimesh + numpy))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Python (trimesh + numpy) that procedurally generates: Build a repeating fence section: two horizontal rail beams connecting a row of evenly spaced vertical picket boards with pointed (pyramid-capped) tops. Picket count, spacing, picket height/width, and rail height must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb, obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
